title: Make pp18_content_search_clear_button_test.dart render the real ContentSearchScreen instead of a hand-rolled TextField clone
rule: TQ-8 (tautological test — doesn't exercise the code it claims to protect)

evidence.quote: /// Helper: builds a minimal TextField that mirrors the ContentSearchScreen

why: This file's docstring says it is the regression test for PP-18 ('No clear (X) affordance in the content-search field') and claims to verify ContentSearchScreen's `InputDecoration.suffixIcon` is wired. It never imports content_search_screen.dart — its own comment admits `buildSearchField()` only 'mirrors' (re-implements by hand) the real screen's decoration logic. The real screen still has the suffixIcon wiring today (content_search_screen.dart:128-133), but I grepped every test in the repo that renders `ContentSearchScreen(` for real — content_search_screen_test.dart (this batch) and content_tile_search_providers_test.dart (outside it) — and neither checks `Icons.clear` or `suffixIcon`. So if a future edit to the real screen breaks or removes the clear button, every test in the repo, including the one named specifically for that bug, stays green.
recommendation: Rewrite the test to pumpWidget the real ContentSearchScreen (reusing the provider overrides from content_search_screen_test.dart), enterText into the real search field, and assert the real Icons.clear IconButton appears/clears/disappears. Delete the hand-rolled buildSearchField helper.
acceptance_criteria: Test imports and pumps ContentSearchScreen; temporarily deleting the suffixIcon block in content_search_screen.dart makes this test fail.
